A little rhythm guide

Catch each seed as its center reaches the gold line. Use A, S, D, the left/down/right arrows, or tap anywhere in a lane.

Perfect
Within 70 ms · 100 points
Good
Within 160 ms · 50 points
Miss
Late or wrong lane · combo resets

Live: when the hamster runs, the real RPM sets the speed and density. All catches score ×2.

Replay: his last 24 hours become 24 three-second sections. Busy hours bring more seeds; quiet hours are a rest. All catches score ×1.

If all 24 hours were quiet, the Start button offers a labeled calm practice track so there are still seeds to catch.

A wake-up switches you to Live without restarting. Press P or Esc to pause. Switching tabs pauses automatically.

Status refreshes every 5 seconds. Offline badges mean the last good status or the built-in calm track is in use. Replay scores are comparable for the same track ID. No account needed.

Sources: wheel status and 24-hour activity.
